about: Taxation & Compliance statutory rule sets. The engines contain NO rates or thresholds: they ask the rule set that applies to the date. Every figure group carries provenance {verification, source, checked_on}. verification: ato_primary = read on an ato.gov.au page; secondary_consistent = several independent professional sources agree but the ATO page was not read; knowledge_unverified = from the maintainers' domain knowledge, NOT confirmed during research - confirm before relying on it; not_loaded = value deliberately empty (the engine then raises a review warning instead of guessing). Organisations can override a value (with a reason, audited) under Tax > Rates & Settings. A tax agent must review this file each 1 July and after each Budget.

low_income_single_threshold.source: PROVISIONAL. These are the 2025-26 single low-income thresholds ($28,011 no levy; $35,013 full levy), stated consistently by several sources. reform.act: Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 (Act No. 49 of 2026), assent 26 June 2026
reform.description: ENACTED. For gains accruing on or after 1 July 2027 the 50% CGT discount for individuals, trusts and partnerships is replaced by cost base indexation and a 30% minimum tax on real gains; gains accrued to 30 June 2027 keep the 50% discount (the 1 July 2027 market value becomes the starting cost base). It does NOT affect any CGT event in the 2026-27 income year (all are before 1 July 2027). AccFino has no rule set for 2027-28, so it cannot prepare a 2027-28 return, and any disposal dated on or after 1 July 2027 raises a review warning. The new regime will be added with a 2027-28 rule set once the ATO publishes the indexation parameters.

_provenance.source: 50% discount applies to CGT events before 1 July 2027 (Budget 2026-27 reform sources). Other CGT parameters from domain knowledge.

reform.source: ATO individuals 'new legislation' page lists the Act and the 1 July 2027 reform; Parliament of Australia bill page: finally passed both Houses 25 June 2026, assent 26 June 2026 (Act No. 49 of 2026)

_provenance.source: ATO 'GDP adjustment for 2026-27 GST and PAYG instalments' (ATO software developers, published 11 June 2026) and ATO 'How we calculate your PAYG instalment amount or rate': the 2026-27 GDP adjustment is 5% (4% in 2025-26). It applies only to instalments worked out by the AMOUNT method; AccFino uses the amount or rate the ATO notified (already uplifted), so it is held here for reference and is NOT applied a second time. The 2026-27 Budget announced 'dynamic PAYG instalments' from 1 July 2027: not modelled.

NSW.source: NSW: Revenue NSW 2026-27 monthly due dates as quoted by secondary sources: 7 Aug, 7 Sep, 7 Oct, 9 Nov, 7 Dec 2026, then 14 Jan (December return: a published exception to the 7th), 8 Feb, 8 Mar, 7 Apr, 7 May, 7 Jun 2027; annual return 28 July 2027. Revenue NSW page not opened.

SA.source: SA: $1,500,000 Australia-wide threshold; variable rate between $1.5m and $1.7m rising to 4.95% (rate = (wages - $1.5m) / $200,000 x 4.95%); 4.95% above $1.7m; maximum deduction $600,000 (prorated by the SA share of wages). Several sources citing RevenueSA's rates page (modified 8 July 2026) agree; the RevenueSA page was not opened. Monthly return by the 7th; annual reconciliation 28 July.

_provenance.source: 2026-27 general annual threshold and rate for NSW ($1.2m, 5.45%, flat), VIC ($1.0m, 4.85%), QLD ($1.3m, 4.75%; 4.95% above $6.5m) and WA ($1.0m, 5.5%) agree across many sources; the state revenue office pages were NOT opened. Monthly returns are due 7 days after month end (next business day). VIC, QLD and WA thresholds taper or are adjusted at higher wage levels, QLD/VIC have regional rates and surcharges, so only NSW is treated as a flat rate. The monitor is a registration-threshold WATCH, not a liability calculator.

rule_sets._about: PROVISIONAL rule set. Prepared so BAS and planning can proceed after 1 July 2027 before the 2027-28 figures are published. Every value except the second tax bracket is carried forward from 2026-27 and graded unverified. A tax agent must confirm it, and values must be replaced when published.
